pt.headline: Ondas perfeitas e vento leve em Supertubos!
pt.advice: Ondas de 1,5 m com período de 9 s e vento de apenas 2 kt prometem tubos limpos. A água está a 16 °C – um 3/2 mm é suficiente. Aviso à navegação costeira ANAV NR 12/24 e ANAV NR 2257/26 em vigor na zona. Chegue cedo para evitar a multidão de fim de semana.
pt.crowdTip: Chegue antes das 09:00 para pegar as melhores linhas antes que o pico encha.

en.headline: Perfect waves and light wind at Supertubos!
en.advice: 1.5 m waves with a 9 s period and only 2 kt of wind give clean barrels. Water is 16 °C – a 3/2 mm wetsuit will keep you warm. Coastal navigation warning ANAV NR 12/24 and ANAV NR 2257/26 are in effect. Arrive early to beat the weekend crowd.
en.crowdTip: Get there before 9 am to catch the best sections before it gets busy.

spots.name: Supertubos
spots.ptReason: Vento leve, ondas consistentes e boa qualidade de tubo; avisos de segurança apenas informativos.
spots.enReason: Light wind, consistent waves and good barrel potential; safety notices are informational only.

spots.name: Guincho
spots.ptReason: Vento forte (8 kt) pode atrapalhar a performance, mas as ondas são boas.
spots.enReason: Strong 8 kt wind may affect performance, though the waves are solid.

spots.name: Nazaré
spots.ptReason: Vento moderado (3 kt) e ondas de 1,5 m; menos lotado que Supertubos.
spots.enReason: Light 3 kt wind and 1.5 m waves; generally less crowded than Supertubos.

spots.name: Ribeira d'Ilhas
spots.ptReason: Vento de 8 kt pode gerar swell irregular; bom spot para quem gosta de long rides.
spots.enReason: 8 kt wind may create irregular swell; good for long rides if you can handle the chop.

spots.name: Coxos
spots.ptReason: Vento moderado (5 kt) e ondas de 1,6 m; ótima para quem procura potência.
spots.enReason: Moderate 5 kt wind and 1.6 m waves; great for surfers seeking power.

spots.name: Arrifana
spots.ptReason: Vento leve (2 kt) e água mais quente; ondas ligeiramente menores, mas ainda divertidas.
spots.enReason: Light 2 kt wind and slightly warmer water; waves are a bit smaller but still fun.

spots.name: Carcavelos
spots.ptReason: Vento forte (8 kt) e ondas menores (1,1 m) tornam o surf menos agradável.
spots.enReason: Strong 8 kt wind and smaller 1.1 m waves make surfing less enjoyable.
